title: Bears LT Ozzy Trapilo will miss most of next season, but Joe Thuney won't move there full time

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears LT Ozzy Trapilo will miss most of next season, but Joe Thuney won't move there full time
sources.description: The Bears selected Ozzy Trapilo in the second round of the 2025 draft, and he played 14 games, with six starts at left tackle, in his rookie season.
